title: Two More Minutes
can_do: 需要从喜欢的活动转场时，请求一小段明确的时间并按约定行动。
trigger: Mom says it is time to leave while the child is still playing with two cars.
core_response: Can I have two more minutes?
stretch_response: Can I have two more minutes to park my cars?
repair_response: Just two minutes, then I will come.
essential_props: two toy cars and a timer

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Shoes on. It is time to leave for the park.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I have two more minutes, please?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Yes. I will set a two-minute timer. What will you finish?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I will park these two cars.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: The timer is ringing. It is time to go.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: My cars are parked. I am putting on my shoes now.

replay_cards.title: Leave the playground
replay_cards.change: Ask for time for one final slide
replay_cards.challenge: Dad agrees to one turn; take the turn and meet him at the gate

replay_cards.title: Pause the puzzle
replay_cards.change: Ask for two minutes to place the last three pieces
replay_cards.challenge: Mom sets the timer; finish or pause when it rings and come to the table

parent_support: Offer a timer only when the schedule really allows it.
When the timer rings, refer to the agreement without turning the moment into a test.
